jobs.name: RAG Reindex (R6)
jobs.description: Reindex all RAG collections, validate embeddings, update cache metadata

jobs.name: Agent Memory Purge (R10)
jobs.description: Delete expired chunks (TTL) and low-rating entries (age > 7 days, rating < 2)

jobs.name: Feedback Loop & Retraining (R9)
jobs.description: Extract user feedback (rating >= 4), retrain reranker, update VERSIONS.json checksum

jobs.name: Health Check
jobs.description: Validate maestro_runs schema, indexes, RLS; check agent_memory size; verify skill checksums; alert Slack if issues

environment_variables.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: Optional: Set via .env or SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL env

scheduling_notes.rag_reindex: Daily @ 02:00 UTC — After midnight, low traffic window
scheduling_notes.agent_memory_purge: Daily @ 03:00 UTC — After RAG reindex completes
scheduling_notes.feedback_loop: Sunday @ 03:00 UTC — Weekly cycle for retraining
